<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def eyes(f):
    s=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(f.ascii.split('\n')):
        for c,ch in enumerate(row):
            if ch=='S': s.add((r,c))
    rs=[x[0] for x in s]; cs=[x[1] for x in s]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
print("before:", eyes(current_frame))

    s=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(f.ascii.split('\n')):
        for c,ch in enumerate(row):
            if ch=='S': s.add((r,c))
    rs=[x[0] for x in s]; cs=[x[1] for x in s]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
